Quick Previews

Hover over items to see quick previews without navigating away from your current view.

previews

Preview endpoints for hover summary cards.

This module provides lightweight, high-speed API endpoints that return just enough data for the hover inspector modals to display contextual summary cards. Unlike the full WBS/resource/location endpoints, these endpoints avoid loading deep relationship graphs, large JSONB attributes, or sub-tree payloads.

Each endpoint enforces ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control) clearance checks. If the requesting user lacks the required security clearance for a node, the sensitive fields are masked as '[RESTRICTED]' and is_masked is set to True — preserving the existence of the node without exposing classified details.

Endpoints

  • GET /api/v1/previews/tasks/{id} — Task hover preview with dates, progress, float, blockers, CDRL, and V&V summary.

  • GET /api/v1/previews/resources/{id} — Resource hover preview with type, location, allocation, and top skills.

  • GET /api/v1/previews/locations/{id} — Location hover preview with tier, SCIF status, and contained asset count.

Performance

These endpoints use targeted select() queries that fetch only the columns needed for each preview type. No eager loading of relationships or cascade joins — each secondary query (assignments, blockers, CDRLs, V&V tests) is a simple indexed lookup by foreign key.

What You Can Do

Viewing Information

  • View: Return a lightweight preview of a PortfolioNode for hover cards.

  • View: Return a lightweight preview of a ResourceNode for hover cards.

  • View: Return a lightweight preview of a LocationNode for hover cards.
